data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Fada' meaning 'to expand' or 'to spread'. The name Femida signifies the feeling of joy, delight, and happiness in Islamic spirituality. The name Femida carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Femida usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
